resources.string: A call that looks real, on Parley\'s call screen, to help you leave somewhere. Answer it and talk; nobody is on the line.
Their photo, ringtone and vibration, as when they call

%1$s calls at about %2$s. Android may ring it a few minutes late.
No rescue call is waiting. The phone restarted or its time passed, so set it again if you need it.
You\'re on a call, so nothing rang.

It isn\'t a call: nothing is dialled, and it isn\'t kept in Recents, notes, statistics or backups. A real call always comes first and ends it. It follows your ring and vibrate switch, and rings even with Do Not Disturb on, as far as Android allows.
A call that looks real, to help you leave
